scripts.dev:compose: sh -lc '(docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker compose up --build) || docker-compose up --build'
scripts.dev:compose:down: sh -lc '(docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker compose down --remove-orphans) || docker-compose down --remove-orphans'
scripts.dev:compose:logs: sh -lc '(docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker compose logs -f) || docker-compose logs -f'

scripts.e2e:stack:down: sh -lc '(docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker compose down --remove-orphans) || docker-compose down --remove-orphans'
